Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
items.charge: Prophesying lies in the Lord's name to the captives; committing adultery with their neighbours' wives

items.title: Alcimus
items.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court

items.title: Aman, who ensnared Achiacharus
items.charge: Treachery against the man who brought him up

items.title: Ananias and Sapphira
items.charge: Lying to the Holy Spirit about a gift

items.title: Andronicus
items.charge: Murder of Onias the high priest under a sworn assurance

items.title: Apollonius
items.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive

items.title: Gehazi
items.charge: Greed and lying to a prophet

items.title: Hananiah the son of Azur
items.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord

items.title: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah
items.charge: Murder of Gedaliah the governor at his own table; slaughter of the Jews and Chaldeans with him, and of seventy pilgrims

items.title: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
items.charge: Asking the word of the Lord, swearing to obey it, and refusing it; burning incense to the queen of heaven in Egypt

items.title: Joseph's brothers
items.charge: Conspiracy to murder; selling a brother; deceiving their father with a bloodied coat

items.title: Judah and Tamar
items.charge: Withholding Shelah from his brother's widow; going in to a woman he took for a harlot

items.title: Potiphar's wife
items.charge: Soliciting her husband's servant day by day, and bearing false witness against him when he fled

items.title: Ptolemy the son of Abubus
items.charge: Murdering Simon the high priest and two of his sons at a banquet in his own castle

items.title: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
items.charge: Sending letters from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks; prophesying a lie

items.title: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
items.charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city for one man's crime

items.title: Simon the governor of the temple
items.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

items.title: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
items.charge: Weakening the hands of the people; hiring counsellors against them to frustrate the building of the house of God

items.title: The Amalekite who claimed to kill Saul
items.charge: Claiming to have slain the Lord's anointed

items.title: The Gibeonites, and Israel's oath
items.charge: Obtaining a covenant by fraud; Israel making it without asking counsel of the Lord

items.title: The man of God from Judah
items.charge: Turning back to eat and drink at Bethel against the word of the Lord

items.title: The old prophet of Beth-el
items.charge: Lying in the name of the Lord, and claiming an angel's word to turn a prophet from his charge

items.title: The priests of Bel
items.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

items.title: The two women before Solomon
items.charge: Conflicting claims to a living child

items.title: Tryphon
items.charge: Taking Jonathan the high priest by treachery under a covenant of friendship; slaying him and the young king Antiochus

items.title: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah, and the four hundred prophets
items.charge: Prophesying victory at Ramoth-gilead by a lying spirit; smiting Micaiah on the cheek
